chunks: He said: And informed me Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Humran, and Humran, and Al-Haytham ibn Waqid Al-Jazari, from Abdullah Al-Arjani, who said: I was with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) when the Virtuous Slave (peace be upon him) entered upon him.

So he said: O Ahmad, do such and such. I said: May I be your ransom, his name is So-and-so. He replied: On the contrary, his name is Ahmad and Muhammad. Then he said to me: O Abdullah, indeed the Master of this Affair will be taken and imprisoned, and his imprisonment will be long. So when they intend to eliminate him, he will supplicate with the Greatest Name of Allah, and He will release him from their hands.

key_terms.أَحْمَدُ وَمُحَمَّدٌ: Ahmad and Muhammad (the names of the Imam)
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: The Virtuous Slave (a title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim)
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: The Master of the Affair (a title for the Imam)

ai.seo_question: What is the prophecy regarding the imprisonment and release of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* serves as a key evidence for the Imamate of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s) by confirming his dual names, Ahmad and Muhammad, and detailing his prolonged imprisonment. It highlights the theological concept of divine protection (*himaya*) for the Imam, where he invokes Allah's Greatest Name (*Ism Allah al-A'zam*) to miraculously escape his enemies, a motif often linked to the concept of *ghayba* (occultation) and eventual return.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 51 - Narrated to me Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Humran and Humran Haitham bin Waqid Jazari from Abdullah Rajani that he said: I was with Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) when Abde Salih, Imam Kadhim (a.s) entered

and Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said: Ahmad, do that. I said: May I be your ransom, his name is so and so (Musa)! He replied: On the contrary, his name is Ahmad and Muhammad. After that he said: O Abdullah, indeed the master of the affair will be arrested and imprisoned for a long time. Thus when they decide to eliminate him, he would pray to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime to release him from their clutches.
